findings.text: follow-on: _repository_relative (reckon/crew/findings.py:90) re-implements the path-normalisation capability reckon/crew/runs.py:521 _repository_relative_scope already owns -- deciding whether a path lies inside a checkout and returning it repository-relative, or None outside -- but with a divergent mechanism (os.path.normpath + startswith versus Path.resolve + relative_to), so the two can disagree on symlinked or ..-bearing paths. The owner was not extended to a root-optional signature; reuse is therefore scored at most 5 and this is recorded rather than repaired.
